transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling TechSavvy Solutions, this is Alex speaking. How can I assist you today?

Customer: Hi Alex, I'm having trouble accessing my account. I can't seem to reset my password.

Agent: I'm sorry to hear that you're having trouble. Can you please provide me with your email address linked to the account?

Customer: Sure, it’s customer123@example.com. 

Agent: Thank you! I see your account here. I'll send a password reset link to that email right now. 

Customer: Great, I appreciate that. But I also noticed my last billing statement was higher than usual. 

Agent: Let’s take a look at that. Were there any additional features or services you might have added recently?

Customer: I was using the Marketing Boost package for a trial last month, but I thought it would switch back to the Pro plan.

Agent: That makes sense. The trial might have overlapped with your billing cycle, causing the increase. Would you like me to adjust that for you?

Customer: Yes, please! I don’t want to keep the marketing features right now.

Agent: No problem, I'll switch you back to the Pro plan immediately. And I'll make sure to credit you for the extra charge. 

Customer: Thank you, that really helps! Can I also ask about the storage capacity on the Pro plan?

Agent: Absolutely! The Pro plan offers up to 100 GB of storage. If you ever need more, we do have an Enterprise plan available that provides 500 GB.

Customer: I see! I may consider that in the future. 

Agent: Sounds good! If you decide to make the switch, feel free to reach out to us anytime. 

Customer: Will do! Thanks for your help today, Alex. 

Agent: You're very welcome! I'm glad I could assist. Have a wonderful day! 

Customer: You too, bye! 

Agent: Bye!
